scope: THE REAL ORACLE FOUND: ui_state (0x84ABA50) = 5 is the loading screen, and it stays 5 while net_state is 10 and an entity is present
why_ui_state_is_the_oracle: net_state is a network-layer value and reads 10 even while the frame shows a loading spinner
ui_state is the FRONTEND state and reads 5, which the early rounds already identified as the loading screen (the code at 0x8037D6 sets ui 5 when a flag equals 2)
so 'the world is visible' corresponds to ui_state != 5, not to net_state == 10
and every acceptance claim should be phrased against ui_state from now on
what_the_combination_means: the client has completed the network handshake (net_state 10)
it has accepted and decoded our entity (count 1, id 4048)
and it still chooses to display the loading screen (ui_state 5)
so the missing condition is in the FRONTEND's map-load completion, not in the network layer or in the entity data
the_direct_next_question: the early rounds located the load-completion chain around 0x8018B0 / 0x803830, and 0x8037D6 is where ui 5 is chosen
so the condition that keeps it at 5 is either one of the flags those addresses test, or a resource the frontend is waiting for
